bytes_in.description: Bytes the proxy read from the client, which is the customer's upload.

bytes_out.description: Bytes the proxy wrote back to the client, which is the customer's download.

current_period_used_bytes.description: Traffic counted against the current allowance period. Lifetime totals remain in bytes_in and bytes_out.

gb_allocated.description: Informational provider balance in decimal GB; billing uses node byte counters.

gb_remaining.description: Informational provider balance in decimal GB; billing uses node byte counters.

gb_used.description: Informational provider balance in decimal GB; billing uses node byte counters.

next_reset_at.description: Next scheduled allowance reset; a past timestamp means confirmation is pending.

period_started_at.description: Start of the current confirmed allowance period, when applicable.

status.description: Compares the change in vendor balance with the change in node counters between two consecutive observations, hourly. `baseline` is the first observation for a service, which has no predecessor to compare with and therefore reports zero drift; it is not a statement that the two figures agree. Billing always uses the node counters.

remaining_bytes.description: Node allowance remaining, floored at zero.

usage_source.description: Billing usage comes from durable, deduplicated node byte counters.
